about: The one place a Hauntology colour, size, space, radius, motion time or font is written down. Edit this file, run `pnpm build-tokens`, commit the generated web/src/styles/tokens.css and shared/src/design/tokens.ts with it. `pnpm check-tokens` fails when they are out of date. Elements (design/elements.css) read the ROLES, never a raw value.

ink-deep.note: black: inside a portrait, a lamp, a meter segment

void.note: true black: the stage in a blackout

wood-2.note: dark brown: raised things (buttons, inputs, nameplates)

ember.note: warm black glow: the faint light at the top of the page

dust.note: grey for quiet SHAPES only (compass ticks). 3.85:1 on ink, so never text

ash.note: warm grey: quiet text, 6.8:1 or better on every surface

ghost.note: green: a rare accent (the Whisper, the tick box)

alarm.note: red: warnings, Stop, the last Haunt segment

art-red.note: game art: red. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-blue.note: game art: blue. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-green.note: game art: green. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-yellow.note: game art: yellow. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-violet.note: game art: violet. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-white.note: game art: white. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-silver.note: game art: silver. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-pink.note: game art: pink. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-gold.note: game art: gold. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-cyan.note: game art: cyan. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-lavender.note: game art: lavender. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-orange.note: game art: orange. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-cream.note: game art: cream. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

art-sun.note: game art: sun yellow. Puzzle content that tells things apart (wire colours, shelf items), never interface colour

surface-sunk.note: a hollow: portrait, lamp, empty meter segment

surface-raised.note: buttons, inputs, nameplates, the dialogue box

surface-hover.note: a raised thing under the pointer

text-quiet.note: labels, hints, scene lines, the Director's quiet words

shape-quiet.note: quiet shapes that carry no words

accent.note: yellow, the main colour: the one main button, edges, lamps, focus, the Keeper

accent-hi.note: the main button under the pointer

accent-rare.note: green, rare: only the Whisper and the tick box

danger.note: warnings, Stop, the last Haunt segment

on-accent.note: text on a solid yellow button

speaker-whisper.note: the Whisper's light, glow and nameplate edge

speaker-keeper.note: the Keeper's light, glow and nameplate edge

speaker-suspect.note: a Suspect's light, glow and nameplate edge

contrast.about: Text colours that must reach `min`:1 on each surface they may sit on. alarm is left off surface-hover on purpose: it is 4.18:1 there, so red words never sit on a hovered brown.

ui.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
ui.note: chrome: every label, button, number and the > prompt

ghost.note: what a ghost says, and titles on the title card

text-size.about: rem, so the player's own text-size setting still works. The px in each note is at the browser default of 16px.

micro.note: 10.5px: key caps, clip note, tiny labels

lead.note: 19 to 22px: the line under a title

space.about: The same 4 px steps as the puzzle screens' --pz-space-1 to -4, with a half step and two larger ones.

0.note: 2px: a label tucked against what it names

frame.note: a portrait's frame, a notice's edge

edge.note: the coloured edge of a nameplate or a story card

lift.note: the transport bar, which floats over the page

motion.about: Fade 300 to 600 ms (steering). Every duration is 0 under prefers-reduced-motion, so an element never needs its own reduced-motion rule for a transition.

fade-slow.note: a light changing, the compass needle, the Haunt filling

breathe.note: the speaking orb, one slow breath. Looping, so reduced motion turns the animation off instead

target-main.note: the main controls: transport buttons and title-card choices

breakpoint.about: A media query cannot read a variable, so these are written out in elements.css and a test keeps them equal to these.

wide.note: the sheet becomes a side panel; the keys line shows
